{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

# Check: how many QA orders are there?
print("Total QA orders:", len(qa_orders))

# Check: how many QA orders are in the 'loyal' and 'completed' group?
qa_in_loyal_completed = qa_orders[(qa_orders['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (qa_orders['status'] == 'completed')]
print("QA orders in loyal completed group:", len(qa_in_loyal_completed))

# Filter for loyal customers and completed orders, excluding QA orders
loyal_completed_clean = sales[(sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & 
                               (sales['status'] == 'completed') & 
                               (sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Count of real completed orders from loyal customers
real_loyal_completed_count = len(loyal_completed_clean)
print("Real completed orders from loyal customers (excluding QA):", real_loyal_completed_count)

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed_clean['revenue_clean'].mean()
print(f"Mean revenue: {mean_revenue}")"}
